questions.question_text: In the figure Statement-I: When $\alpha>\beta \ge 0$ , the section is hyperbola Statement-II: When $\beta>90^{\circ}$ , the section is ellipse Which of the following is correct?
questions.question_html:
In the figure

Statement-I: When $\alpha>\beta \ge 0$ , the section is hyperbola
Statement-II: When $\beta>90^{\circ}$ , the section is ellipse
Which of the following is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Statement I is true, Statement II is false
options.html: Statement I is true, Statement II is false

options.label: B
options.text: Statement I is false, Statement II is true
options.html: Statement I is false, Statement II is true

options.label: C
options.html: Both the Statements are true

options.label: D
options.html: Both the Statements are false

questions.explanation_text: Let $\alpha$ be the semi-vertical angle of the cone, and let $\beta$ be the angle between the cutting plane and the axis of the cone. The conic section depends on the comparison between $\alpha$ and $\beta$ . If $0 \le \beta<\alpha$ , the plane cuts both parts, or nappes, of the cone. The section formed is a hyperbola. If $\beta=\alpha$ , the plane is parallel to a generator of the cone. The section formed is a parabola. If $\alpha<\beta<90^{\circ}$ , the plane cuts only one nappe of the cone. The section formed is an ellipse. If $\beta=90^{\circ}$ , the plane is perpendicular to the axis of the cone. The section formed is a circle. Now, Statement-I says that when $\alpha>\beta \ge 0$ , the section is a hyperbola. This is the same as $0 \le \beta<\alpha$ , so Statement-I is true. The angle $\beta$ is the angle between the plane and the axis, so it is taken between $0^{\circ}$ and $90^{\circ}$ . Hence, $\beta>90^{\circ}$ is not considered here. So Statement-II is false. Answer: Statement I is true, Statement II is false.
questions.explanation_html:
Let $\alpha$ be the semi-vertical angle of the cone, and let $\beta$ be the angle between the cutting plane and the axis of the cone.

The conic section depends on the comparison between $\alpha$ and $\beta$ .

If $0 \le \beta<\alpha$ , the plane cuts both parts, or nappes, of the cone. The section formed is a hyperbola.

If $\beta=\alpha$ , the plane is parallel to a generator of the cone. The section formed is a parabola.

If $\alpha<\beta<90^{\circ}$ , the plane cuts only one nappe of the cone. The section formed is an ellipse.

If $\beta=90^{\circ}$ , the plane is perpendicular to the axis of the cone. The section formed is a circle.

Now, Statement-I says that when $\alpha>\beta \ge 0$ , the section is a hyperbola. This is the same as $0 \le \beta<\alpha$ , so Statement-I is true.

The angle $\beta$ is the angle between the plane and the axis, so it is taken between $0^{\circ}$ and $90^{\circ}$ . Hence, $\beta>90^{\circ}$ is not considered here. So Statement-II is false.

Answer: Statement I is true, Statement II is false.

questions.question_html: The distance between the foci of a hyperbola is 16 and its eccentricity is $\sqrt{2}$ . Its equation is
questions.explanation_text: Given, distance between the foci $=16$ and $\begin{aligned} e & =\sqrt{2} \\ 2ae & =16 \\ ae & =8 \\ \Rightarrow a & =\frac{8}{\sqrt{2}}=4\sqrt{2} \end{aligned}$ So, $\begin{aligned} & b^{2}=a^{2}(e^{2}-1) \\ & b^{2}=32(2-1)=32 \end{aligned}$ Equation of hyperbola is $\begin{aligned} & \frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}}-\frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}}=1 \\ & \frac{x^{2}}{32}-\frac{y^{2}}{32}=1 \\ & \Rightarrow x^{2}-y^{2}=32 \end{aligned}$
questions.explanation_html:
Given, distance between the foci $=16$ and

$\begin{aligned} e & =\sqrt{2} \\ 2ae & =16 \\ ae & =8 \\ \Rightarrow a & =\frac{8}{\sqrt{2}}=4\sqrt{2} \end{aligned}$

So,

$\begin{aligned} & b^{2}=a^{2}(e^{2}-1) \\ & b^{2}=32(2-1)=32 \end{aligned}$

Equation of hyperbola is

$\begin{aligned} & \frac{x^{2}}{a^{2}}-\frac{y^{2}}{b^{2}}=1 \\ & \frac{x^{2}}{32}-\frac{y^{2}}{32}=1 \\ & \Rightarrow x^{2}-y^{2}=32 \end{aligned}$
